summary: Golub Capital Private Income Fund I filed an 8-K covering three routine items: an unregistered sale of 102,555 common shares at $24.27 NAV per share for $2.489M total consideration, exempt under Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation D/S; a declared regular June distribution of $0.1667 per share payable July 30, 2026; and portfolio commentary as of May 31, 2026. The filing contains no special-situation M&A, activist, restructuring, or similar event. It is a normal periodic disclosure of capital-raising, dividend declaration, and portfolio statistics, not a special situation.
